info.name: Project Resource Allocation System
info.description:
SIST CSE Capstone Project - REST API tests.

Before running:
1. Load database/schema.sql and database/sample-data.sql into MySQL.
2. Start the Spring Boot application (it listens on port 8080).

Every folder contains a successful request, an invalid request that must
return HTTP 400, and a missing-record request that must return HTTP 404.

item.name: 5. Allocations
item.description: Allocation CRUD. A successful save may still return a 'warnings' list when it creates a skill gap or a conflict.

request.description: Karthik has Java and Spring Boot, so this should save with no warnings.

item.name: Create an allocation that RAISES A SKILL GAP (201 + warnings)

request.description: Priya has no backend skills. The allocation is saved, but the response carries a SKILL GAP warning - the assignment is never silent.
Expect 400: 'Allocation percentage must be between 1 and 100'.
Expect 400: allocation dates must be inside the project dates.
Expect 404: 'Developer not found with id 999'.
Deletes one of the allocations created above. Change the id if needed.

item.name: 6. Leave
item.description: Planned leave, which drives the LEAVE CONFLICT rule.

request.description: Rahul is allocated on these dates, so /api/conflicts will now report an extra LEAVE CONFLICT.
Expect 400: 'Leave end date cannot be before leave start date'.
Expect 404: 'Developer not found with id 999'.

item.name: 7. Conflicts, skill gaps and utilization
item.description: The detection rules. With the shipped sample data these return one over-allocation, one leave conflict and two skill gaps.

request.description:
CASE 1: Rahul reaches 110% between 15 Sep and 15 Oct 2026.
CASE 3: Divya's September and November work does NOT overlap, so it raises nothing.
CASE 5: Priya is 80% allocated during her leave 10-14 Sep 2026.

item.name: Conflicts of developer 1 - Arun, expect none (200)

request.description: CASE 2 style: Arun is at 60%, inside his availability, so the list comes back empty.
CASE 4: 'Cloud Deployment' needs Azure and nobody has it, so the suggestion is 'Skill Gap: No available developer has this skill.'
Arun 60% Available, Priya 80% High Load, Rahul 110% Conflict.

item.name: 8. Budget and forecast
item.description: Budget maths, the burn-rate forecast and the guards.

request.description: 500,000 budget, 300,000 spent -> 60% utilization.
CASE 6: remaining 200,000 at a burn rate of 10,000 per day gives 'approximately 20 days'.
90% used -> warningLevel CRITICAL.

item.name: Budget of project 3 - NO SPENDING DATA (200)

request.description: Nothing spent, so no division happens and the message is 'No spending data available'.
Also returns 'No spending data available' instead of dividing by zero.
Expect 400: 'Amount must be greater than zero'.
Expect 404: 'Project not found with id 999'.
Regenerates alerts for over-allocation, leave conflicts, skill gaps, budget risks, delays and approaching deadlines. Running it twice does not create duplicates.
Expect 404: 'Notification not found with id 999'.

item.name: 10. Simulations
item.description: The what-if simulator. RUN never writes to the database; only SAVE does.

item.name: RUN a simulation - nothing is saved (200)

request.description:
Replaces Rahul with Karthik on Frontend Development.
Afterwards, GET /api/simulations still returns an empty list, which proves the run wrote nothing.
Should still be empty if you have not saved a scenario yet.
Only this call writes a row into simulation_scenarios.
Returns application/pdf. Use 'Send and Download' in Postman.
Builds the report without storing anything.
